SOURCE_A: 神峰通考, 卷二 (飛天祿馬格 section)

PROPOSITION_A: 格 = 飛天祿馬 (an 外格 built on 暗沖). Mechanism asserted: 庚 born in 申 month with doubled 子申 makes water dominant; that water 冲s 午, activating the LATENT 丁/己 hidden in 午 as 財官 — the chart's nobility comes from 財官 that are absent from the chart and must be summoned by 冲.運: 再行北方 (northern/water 運) intensifies the 冲 and is favorable, provided the 身主 has 氣. (The 古歌 printed immediately above in the same section adds 如行金水多清贵，运转南方数有难.)

Mechanism asserted: born in the 7th month the 氣候 is not yet cold, so 金水傷官 WITHOUT 官煞 does not damage the nobility — the merit lies precisely in 官煞 being ABSENT. 運: 宜金水本地; bringing in 官煞/火 運 is 反不相宜; 土運 harmless because 甲木 counter-checks it; principle = 順其氣勢以取運.

REFUTATION ATTEMPT LARGELY FAILED — the core of the claim survives. Both quotations are literally present, verbatim, and I confirmed each on two independent hosts by raw curl + local tag-stripping (no summarizer). The chart is identical in both sources with no 己/已/巳 or 戊/戌 corruption possible. So I could NOT refute chart, quote A, or quote B.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM, and what the claim gets wrong:

1. CITATION ERROR (confirmed defect). The claim's source-B URL is the book index only, and it names 論建祿月劫 (ch.45). The quoted text is in ch.46 論建祿月劫取運 (.../53716.html). Working: 33856.html, 53715.html, 53716.html, cnddy.com/1583.html, 8bei8.com/book/zipingzhenquanpingzhu_47.html and _48.html. Failed: ctext.org search (403).

2. B IS NOT AN INDEPENDENT WITNESS TO THE CHART. 徐樂吾 opens "此本篇高尚书命" — the chart of THIS chapter's 原文. The chart and the 高尚書 attribution belong to 沈孝瞻's Qing-era 子平真詮 (verified in ch.45), not to 徐. So this is a three-layer stack (張楠 Ming → 沈孝瞻 Qing → 徐樂吾 Republican), not two authorities. The interpretation is independent; the case datum is inherited. I could not determine whether 沈孝瞻 took the case from 張楠 — he does not cite him, but both call the subject a 尚書 surnamed 高 (A gives the fuller 高功韶), which points to shared transmission rather than parallel discovery.

3. B CONTRADICTS ITSELF, and the claimant reported only the half that fits. ch.46: 运宜金水本地，再行官煞火运，反不相宜 (fire/官煞 運 unsuitable), with a 順行 大運 乙酉丙戌丁亥戊子己丑庚寅. ch.45: 逆行水木火地均美 (reverse-running through water/wood/FIRE all fine). Same author, same book, opposite 運 direction and opposite verdict on 火. That materially degrades B's reliability as a reasoning source and would poison any engine that ingested only one of the two.

4. I could NOT confirm 高功韶 as a historically attested Ming 尚書 in any biographical or historical source — I checked only divination literature. The person may be literary.

5. I could NOT confirm text-critical independence of the two hosts. Both A copies share the same anomalies (金水两千 for what should be 金水两干; 庚申日主 against a printed 庚子 day pillar), so they likely descend from one digitization. No print edition was consulted. Treat "two hosts" as availability corroboration, not as textual-witness independence.

WHY GRADE B, NOT A: they are not answering the same question. A assigns 飛天祿馬 and locates the nobility in 財官 that must be 冲'd out of a hidden 午; B assigns 祿劫化為傷官/金水傷官 and locates the nobility in 官煞 being ABSENT. These are opposite accounts of where the value comes from — a genuine cross-lineage divergence on mechanism. Their conclusions are nonetheless compatible: both affirm 貴, and both favor 金水 運 (A's own adjacent 古歌 says 如行金水多清贵，运转南方数有难, matching B's 官煞火运反不相宜). Grade A would require same question + both detailed + clean independence; this fails on all three. Grade C/D would understate it — the sources are genuinely 350 years and two doctrinal systems apart, and B supplies substantial new reasoning (會局, 氣候/七月未寒, 原局無火, 順其氣勢, explicit 大運). B is the honest grade.

FOUR_PILLARS_AS_REPORTED: 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申
SOURCE_A: 神峰通考, 卷一 (女命 section)
AUTHORITY_A: 張楠 (神峰子), Ming
ORIGINAL_TEXT_A: 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申／青女命去杀留官格／楠曰：杀星得制独留官，官杀相停两得安。最喜南方官旺地，时师莫作等闲看。／辛金生寅，本畏丁火为杀，得丁壬化之。更畏丙火官星太重，喜有申中壬水，冲去月上丙火，独存时日丙火为夫星。原夫星气弱，喜行甲乙丙丁旺夫之地。夫作廉吏，其贵宜矣。
SOURCE_B: 子平真詮評註, 第07章 論刑冲會合解法
AUTHORITY_B: 徐樂吾
ORIGINAL_TEXT_B: 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申／酉巳之会，因隔寅木而不成局；寅申之冲，亦因隔巳火而不成冲；且巳申刑而带合，去申中庚金，使其不伤寅木，财官之用无损，便成贵格。此造摘自《神峰通考》。
INDEPENDENCE_GRADE: DERIVED_WITH_NEW_REASONING — B's own final sentence is the admission: "此造摘自《神峰通考》" (this chart is excerpted from Shenfeng Tongkao). So this is NOT independent attestation of the case; the chart travels from A to B by acknowledged borrowing. But B is emphatically not a reprint: he reproduces none of A's reasoning, none of A's verse, none of A's 夫星 framing, and no part of A's prose. He applies entirely different machinery (positional blocking under 刑冲会合解法 — 巳酉 fails to 会 because 寅 intervenes; 寅申 fails to 冲 because 巳 intervenes; 巳申 is a 刑 carrying 合 that strips 申's 庚金) and uses the case for a purpose A never raised. Substantively independent analysis of a borrowed case.

AUTHORITY_VERIFIED: VERIFIED — genuinely two different authorities, not a reprint or a shared commentary layer. A: 張楠 (号 神峰子), Ming, 臨川; 神峰通考 is his own work, and the passage is marked with his personal siglum "楠曰" (Nan says). B: 徐樂吾 (1886-1949), Republican era; 子平真詮評註 is his commentary on 沈孝瞻's Qing-era 子平真詮, and the passage sits under "徐注" (Xu's note), not under the 原文. Roughly 350-400 years and two different schools apart — 神峰通考 is the heterodox 病藥 school explicitly written to correct earlier 子平 texts, while 子平真詮 is the orthodox 格局 line. Distinct authors, distinct works, distinct commentary layers, distinct websites. The only shared element is the chart itself, which B openly borrows.
PROPOSITION_A: "For the female chart 辛 day / 寅 month, 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申: the 七杀 (丁) is neutralized by 丁壬 combination and the surplus 正官 (丙) is removed, leaving a single 丙 as the 夫星 — i.e. this is a 去杀留官 structure with 官杀 balanced (官杀相停两得安). Because that surviving husband-star is weak in qi, 甲乙丙丁 / southern 官旺 luck is the favorable direction, and the outcome is a noble chart whose husband serves as an upright official (夫作廉吏/廉使)." A's question is: how do 官 and 杀 resolve, what is the 夫星, and which luck direction follows?
PROPOSITION_B: "For 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申, branch interactions do not fire merely because the branches are present — spacing decides. 酉 and 巳 cannot form the half-metal 会 because 寅木 sits between them; 寅 and 申 cannot 冲 because 巳火 sits between them; and 巳申 operates as a 刑 that carries 合, which removes the 庚金 inside 申 so that it cannot injure 寅木. The 財官 用神 therefore survives undamaged and the chart forms a 貴格." B's question is: which of the nominally-present 刑冲会合 actually operate given positional adjacency, and does the 用神 survive them?
SAME_PROPOSITION: DIFFERENT_PROPOSITION_COMPATIBLE — both reach 貴 for the same chart, but they are answering different questions (A: 官杀去留 and 夫星/運 for a 女命; B: which branch relations actually operate and whether the 用神 survives), and neither derives its conclusion from the other's premises. Compatible in verdict, but with a real mechanical tension that should be recorded rather than smoothed over: A has the 申 actively supplying 壬水 that 冲s away a fire 官, whereas B rules that the 寅申 冲 does not operate at all and that what 巳申 removes is 申's 庚金. A's protected interest is fire (官/夫星, wants 南方); B's protected interest is 寅木 財 plus 官. So the shared "貴" label rests on non-shared mechanisms — which is what makes the pair useful as a bridge, but also means it is not two authorities affirming one proposition.
REFUTATION_NOTES:
I tried to refute this and could not. The core of the claim survives raw-literal verification: the eight characters 丁酉 壬寅 辛巳 丙申 are printed identically in both sources across four independently-hosted copies, both reported quotations are exact substrings of raw retrieved page text (verified by programmatic substring test on curl-fetched HTML, never through a summarizer), and 張楠 and 徐樂吾 are genuinely two different men writing ~350-400 years apart in two different schools, under their own sigla (楠曰 / 徐注). Grade B, not REFUTED.

What I could NOT confirm, and what the claim got wrong:

1. INDEPENDENCE IS NOT CLEAN, AND THE CLAIM DOES NOT SAY SO. Source B's own closing sentence is 此造摘自《神峰通考》 — Xu Leowu states he took the chart from Zhang Nan. This is one case travelling from A to B by acknowledged borrowing, not two lineages encountering it separately. If the intended use is "two traditions independently attest this chart", that use is refuted. If the intended use is "a second lineage re-analyses the same case with its own machinery", that stands.

2. THE URL FOR AUTHORITY B IS WRONG. The claim cites the book INDEX page (.../zipingzhenquanpingzhu/). I retrieved it: it contains only the chapter list and a blurb, and does NOT contain the quote. The real location is .../zipingzhenquanpingzhu/53677.html.

3. THE QUOTED TEXT A IS EDITION-SPECIFIC AND ITS HEADING IS PROBABLY CORRUPT. An independent host (book.tjsay.com p44) prints the same case as 贵女命去留官格 (not 青女命去杀留官格), 最喜南方官旺也 (not 官旺地), 夫作廉使 (not 廉吏). "青女命" is very likely a 貴→青 graphic corruption in the diancang text the claim transcribed. The chart and the analytical prose are otherwise identical, so this does not break the case, but the reported label should not be treated as the authoritative title.

4. BOTH EDITIONS OF A CARRY AN INTERNAL DEFECT. "喜有申中壬水，冲去月上丙火" is incoherent against the chart it accompanies: the month pillar printed in every copy is 壬寅, which contains no 丙. This corruption is present in both independent copies of A, so it is inherited from the received text, not a hosting error. Any reasoning engine that consumes A's mechanism verbatim will be consuming a defective sentence.

5. THEY ARE NOT ANSWERING THE SAME QUESTION, and I would not grade this A on that ground alone. A resolves 官杀去留 and derives the 夫星 and luck direction for a 女命; B decides which 刑冲会合 actually operate given branch spacing and whether the 用神 survives. Both land on 貴, but by mechanisms that partly conflict: A has 申 supplying water that clashes fire away, while B rules the 寅申 clash inoperative and has 巳申 stripping 申's metal instead. Same verdict, non-shared reasoning.

6. RESIDUAL LIMIT I CANNOT CLOSE. Everything here is modern digitised text. I did not check any printed critical edition or facsimile, so a transmission-level error older than all these websites cannot be excluded — and item 4 shows the received text demonstrably does carry such errors.

WHAT I COULD CONFIRM (all by raw literal retrieval, two hosts per source, never a summarizer): the chart's four pillars are identical in both sources; both reported quotations are literally present, character-exact, contiguous apart from line breaks; the two authors are genuinely distinct persons writing distinct books. On those four points the claim is accurate and I could not refute it.

WHAT I REFUTE: the load-bearing implication that this is a CROSS-LINEAGE bridge — two independent authorities converging on one chart. It is not. 徐樂吾 published 任鐵樵's annotated 滴天髓 BEFORE writing 子平真詮評註, stated in that book's own preface: 「今徐子樂吾，既將任註《滴天髓》印行於前，復將《子平真詮》評註於後」(diancang /53669.html, corroborated at 8bei8 page 1). B is the editor and publisher of A quoting his own prior publication. Two agreeing texts where one author printed the other are ONE witness, not two — the agreement carries no corroborative weight, which is the entire point of a bridge case.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM: (1) that 反為四助 predates 任鐵樵 — if it were an older shared formula, Xu's reuse would be less probative; I found no pre-Ren occurrence and did not establish one either way. (2) Print-edition fidelity — all four retrievals trace to the modern Chinese digital-text ecosystem, which likely shares an upstream OCR base; I did not consult a scanned or physical edition, so cross-host agreement bounds host-level error but not base-text error. (3) The claim silently propagates a corruption: A's fifth luck pillar reads 乙未 where the descending sequence requires 己未 (as B correctly prints). This is precisely the 己/乙-class character error the brief asked me to hunt — it lands in the luck pillars, not the four pillars, so it does not break the chart comparison, but a claim that reproduces two divergent readings without noticing the divergence was not checked at character level by its author.

GRADE D, not REFUTED: nothing factually asserted is false, and the reasoning in both passages is real and usable. But independence — the one property that makes a bridge a bridge — fails on documented evidence. Do not use this pair as independent corroboration. It is usable only as what it actually is: one commentator carrying a case from a book he published into a book he wrote, and re-explaining it under a different doctrinal heading with added positional analysis.

(d) DECISIVE: I grepped all 64 chapters of 滴天髓闡微 and found that B's ENTIRE three-chart 子午卯酉 demonstration set is taken from 任鐵樵, with his wording. 癸酉甲子丁卯丙午 is in 任's 通关 chapter (33485.html), where he writes 尤妙四冲反为四助 — B writes 子午卯酉，四冲也...反为四助. 乾隆's 辛卯丁酉庚午丙子 is in 任's 知命 chapter (33469.html), where he writes 最喜子午逢冲...使午火不破酉金；更妙卯酉逢冲...则卯木不助午火 — B writes 妙在卯酉冲，使卯木不能生火，子午冲，使午火不破酉金. The distinctive clause 使午火不破酉金 is verbatim. B assembled his illustration from A's casebook.

WHAT B GENUINELY ADDS (why not REFUTED outright): the comparative frame is 徐's own — he re-purposes three scattered 任 cases into one argument that 冲 is not intrinsically destructive but position-dependent, importing them into 子平真詮's 生克先後 doctrine, a question 任鐵樵 was not asking. He also re-derives 大運 lists (his 乾隆 sequence 丙申乙未甲午癸巳壬辰辛卯庚寅己丑 is complete where the 闡微 digitization drops 甲午 and 辛卯). And one mechanism is reframed: A blames 子午冲 for 使伤官得以肆逞, B for 印之根为财所破 — same event, different causal emphasis. But about THIS chart specifically, B contributes no new evidence and no new reasoning; he compresses A and hardens the verdict, dropping A's countervailing 文采风流、精于书法 and A's attribution of the blockage to mid-life 金水 luck. Net: a second voice, not a second witness.

VERDICT: same chart, same proposition, same answer, both verified — but confirmation here is circular. Using B to corroborate A double-counts 任鐵樵. Grade D: real text, real distinct authors, failed independence. Do not use as a cross-lineage bridge.

PROPOSITION_A:
任鐵樵 asserts a chart-intrinsic structural proposition: in 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 壬午, the apparent co-prosperity of self and wealth (身財並旺) is illusory, because the 財 star is destroyed at every layer simultaneously — the 己土 wealth on the stem is stripped by the 乙 比肩 flanking it; the 丑土 wealth in the branch is broken by 卯木; the 午火 食神 that would channel self into wealth is attacked by 亥水 and capped from above by 壬水 (壬水蓋之), leaving 無從引化 (no route of transmission). Therefore the stems and branches are 上下無情 — vertically uncooperative — and per the governing verse 上下貴乎情協 the life must collapse.

Prediction attached: early luck 戊寅/丁丑 supports the 財 (inherited wealth), then 丙子 clashes out 午火 and 乙亥 completes the ruin. Formal role in the text: this is the NEGATIVE half of a deliberate matched pair, offered as proof of the verse (「合此兩造觀之…遂判天淵，即於此證驗焉」).
PROPOSITION_B:
韋千里 asserts a chart-intrinsic structural proposition about the same eight characters, in the opposite direction.

B1 (千里命稿): the distinction of the chart is 交互得祿 — each of the three stems 乙, 己, 壬 finds its 祿 in a branch belonging to another pillar (乙祿在卯, 己祿在午, 壬祿在亥), so the pillars mutually underwrite one another; with 木旺水健 and 午 providing 洩秀, the structure is 格局清奇 and the life stands 在萬民之上. Note this is an ex post reading of a known outcome, not a blind prediction.

B2 (呱呱集): 月令建祿 with 亥卯 forming a wood frame yields a strong self that can carry wealth (身旺任財); the merit is that 己 (wealth) and 壬 (resource) are both transparent on the stems and both rooted (並得祿於亥午). The qualification: 福澤猶嫌不足, hence eminent but 未執政, 杌陧不安.

The head-on collision is at the level of the same four elements. A reads 己 as robbed by 比肩, 午 as a 食神 under attack, 壬 as a lid that blocks transmission, 亥 as the attacker. B reads that identical 己/壬/午/亥 set as 財印兩透並得祿於亥午 — mutually supporting. Same components, contradictory structural verdict.
SAME_PROPOSITION:
SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER

Both authorities answer the same chart-intrinsic question — "in 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 壬午, is the 己土 wealth functional, and do the stems and branches cooperate?" — and answer it oppositely. A: the wealth is destroyed on every axis and the configuration is 無情. B: the wealth is carried (身旺任財), the stems mutually 得祿, and the configuration is 清奇. This is not a label difference; the two decompose the identical 己/壬/午/亥 relationships in incompatible ways.

Two honest qualifications that stop this from being a clean same-frame contradiction:
1. Asymmetric doctrinal frames. A is answering inside 情協 doctrine (a 滴天髓 category); B is answering inside 祿/格局 doctrine. Neither engages the other's category, so no shared adjudication rule exists between them. They contradict on the object, not within a shared method.
2. Different subjects, which supplies an orthodox escape hatch. A's man and 段祺瑞 are different people with the same eight characters. A defender of both can dissolve the outcome-level conflict as ordinary 同八字異命 without conceding any doctrinal error. What survives that escape is only the structural half — whether 己土財 is usable — because that claim is about the chart alone. The bridge is therefore real but narrower than "two masters disagree about one life."
REFUTATION_NOTES:
I set out to refute this and could not. The core of the claim survives adversarial retrieval: the chart, both quotations, and the two-distinct-authorities point are all CONFIRMED by raw literal retrieval across six working URLs and multiple independent hosts. That said, the claim is overstated in several specific, checkable ways, which is why I grade B rather than A.

WHAT I CONFIRMED
- The eight characters 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 壬午 are printed identically in both sources, in 3 mirrors each. Character-confusion is ruled out structurally (己 not 已/巳; no 戊/戌 in the chart; all eight glyphs script-invariant; the chart is internally consistent under 五虎遁 and 五鼠遁, which a one-character corruption would break; and 1865-03-06 computes to 乙亥 day against a verified 60-day anchor).
- Quote A verbatim, in the correct chapter, under the correct verse, in the correct position.
- Quote B verbatim, in both works, correctly described as an aside on an anonymous client's chart.
- Independence is genuinely high: B cites neither 滴天髓 nor 任鐵樵, shares essentially no analytic vocabulary with A, and is about a different person.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM — the honest list
1. 「道光 era」 for 任鐵樵. Zero hits for 道光 across all A-mirrors; wikisource says only 「清」. Unsupported by my evidence.
2. 韋千里's dates (1911–1988) and 千里命稿's 1935 date. Zero hits. Unsupported by my evidence.
3. Any scan-level or edition-level verification. Every source is a modern simplified-Chinese web digitization with demonstrable OCR noise (「一郊」/「一交」 divergence between A-mirrors; 「午水泄秀」 and 「杌楻」 in B). I inspected no photographed original, no 1933 袁樹珊 印本, no critical edition. Textual variants across 滴天髓闡微 editions are a known hazard and I did not close it. If the hour pillar differs in some printed edition, my three mirrors would not reveal it.
4. That 段祺瑞's birth data actually is 1865-03-06 midday. My day-pillar computation shows the chart is CONSISTENT with that date; it does not establish the date. If 韋千里 inherited a wrong chart for 段, the whole bridge is a comparison of a real chart against a misattributed one, and nothing I retrieved can exclude that.
5. The claim's chapter attribution 「應運篇上」 is supported by only one of three hosts; the others label the same content 評斷篇 第17章 / 第二十二頁.

WHERE THE CLAIM OVERREACHES
- It presents B1 and B2 as mutually reinforcing. They are one author speaking twice and they DISAGREE: 「故在萬民之上」 (B1) versus 「福澤猶嫌不足…雖貴未執政」 (B2). Treating them as two data points double-counts a single authority, and the later revision undercuts the earlier verdict the bridge leans on.
- Its ellipses are load-bearing three times: they drop A's 「初逢戊寅丁丑，財逢生助，遺業頗豐」 (A's man was RICH first — quoting only the ruin misrepresents A's reading), drop B2's 「並得祿於亥午」 (actual reasoning, not filler), and land precisely on B1's corrupt 「午水洩秀」.
- 「both detailed」 fails. A is a full case with luck-cycle reasoning and staged outcome. B1 is four clauses of contrastive aside on a chart that is not the one under analysis; B2 is roughly thirty characters. The reasoning volume is badly asymmetric.
- The two authorities analyze DIFFERENT PEOPLE. An orthodox defender dissolves the outcome-level conflict as 同八字異命 at no doctrinal cost. What genuinely survives is the narrower structural contradiction — whether 己土財 is usable, and whether 己/壬/午/亥 cooperate or annihilate — which is real and is what makes this worth a B.

VERDICT: not refuted, but not grade A. Same chart (verified), two independent authorities (verified), related-to-same question (verified), asymmetric and thin reasoning on the B side, single-author double-counting, unverified biographical metadata, and no edition-level textual control.

PROPOSITION_A: For the four pillars 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 癸未: spring wood forms a complete 局 (亥卯未 三合木局 with 乙 born in 卯 month) and there is NO metal in the four pillars (四柱無金); therefore the chart is 曲直仁壽格 — a 專旺 (exclusive-prosperity) wood structure, which 徐樂吾 files under 取用之法 (四) 專旺, i.e. the correct handling is to follow the dominant qi rather than oppose it. Subject identity asserted: 段執政祺瑞 (Duan Qirui).
PROPOSITION_B: For the same four pillars 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 癸未: 乙 born in 卯 month with 支全木局 is granted, BUT 辛 lies hidden in the year branch 丑 (年支丑中藏辛), and that hidden metal breaks the structure — 曲直已破. Therefore the chart is NOT 曲直仁壽格 and can only be judged as 身旺財輕 (strong self, weak wealth). Subject identity asserted: an anonymous retired official who fell on hard times after thirty and lived by his calligraphy — explicitly NOT 段祺瑞, whose chart 韋千里 gives as 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 壬午 (交互得祿, 格局清奇), one hour pillar away.
SAME_PROPOSITION:
SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER

Both authorities answer the identical question — "does 乙丑 己卯 乙亥 癸未 form 曲直(仁壽)格?" — and return opposite answers. This is not a labels-differ artifact. The disagreement isolates one concrete, nameable doctrinal premise:

徐樂吾's stated ground is 四柱無金 — no metal in the four pillars.
韋千里 denies exactly that ground — 年支丑中藏辛 — by counting 藏干 (hidden stems) inside 丑.

So the contradiction reduces to a single rule: does the "no metal" requirement of a 專旺 wood 格 range over manifest stems and branches only, or does it also range over hidden stems? That is a clean, machine-representable doctrinal fork, and it is the reason the two verdicts diverge. 韋千里 even names the stakes himself: 八字之相差一時。其土壤徑庭 — one hour's difference, worlds apart.

Secondary, separable disagreement: the two also contradict each other on subject IDENTITY (whose chart this is). That is a factual dispute, not a doctrinal one, and should be kept in a different slot from the 格局 dispute.

If the rubric weights argumentative depth on both sides, this is an A/B boundary case; I graded A because the propositions are the SAME question rather than merely related, which is the harder half of the rubric to satisfy.
5. Methodological caveat on both authorities: neither reasoned blind. 徐 knew the subject was a head of state; 韋 knew his client's career had stalled. This does not refute the bridge — it means the bridge documents a doctrinal disagreement, not two blind independent readings converging or diverging.

That site replaces 交 with 郊 (I proved this from the file itself: its own meta tag preserves 交媾/交戰 where the body prints 郊*/郊战). Three characters in the reported quote are wrong. 3. NEITHER WITNESS OF B IS A WITNESS OF THE PRINTED BOOK. Both suanzhun.net and zh.wikisource carry the identical suspect reading 「日和不克」, which strongly indicates one shared digital transcription ancestor rather than two independent copies. 4. SAME CHART ≠ SAME CASE — and this is the strongest surviving objection. Both texts are anonymous: A names no person and gives no 大運; B gives a biography but no name. 壬子/丙午 doubled is the maximally symmetric water-fire configuration, the natural type-specimen any author would construct unaided, which is precisely why independent invention is more likely here than borrowing. So the two authorities may simply be judging two different individuals who share a bazi — a situation classical 命理 explicitly tolerates. On that reading the divergence (太貴 vs. 乞丐→富) is not a doctrinal contradiction at all. There is a second escape hatch: A speaks at 格 level (the structure is not broken by 衝併) and B at 運 level (the early luck was ruinous), and 命貴 with 運不助 is a standard, non-contradictory pairing. I judged SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER because B's subject never attains 貴 and B's own 原註 layer holds 「交戰身弱，豈能富貴？」 — but a careful opponent can defend DIFFERENT_PROPOSITION_COMPATIBLE, and I cannot close that off from the texts alone.

WHY B AND NOT A: grade A requires both sides detailed. A is one clause — a 格 label, a verdict, and a dismissal of the clash objection. No strength analysis, no luck periods, no mechanism. B is fully worked. Grade A also requires the same question; the questions are adjacent (A ranks 貴賤 at 格 level, B narrates 富 and 運), not identical. Grade B fits: same chart, two genuinely independent authorities, related question, usable reasoning on both sides.

WHY NOT DOWNGRADE TO C/D: the two authorities are unambiguously distinct works, layers, and centuries; there is no citation link, and a copyist would not invert the verdict. A does supply usable reasoning (既濟 vs. 未濟 contrast, an explicit rejection of the 衝併 objection, and the alternative 聚精會神 reading). Nothing suggests reprint or shared commentary layer, so DERIVED_* and REPRINT_ONLY are excluded.

SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER — but NOT along the axis the claim needs.

Both A-juan11 and B answer the same question: what格 is this chart, and what does it want in運? Their answers are strictly opposed on the operative variable. A-juan11: 喜印綬、怕財尅 (Print is the friend, Wealth is the enemy). B: 運喜財官, and 有印則印以化煞而不從 (Wealth is the friend, Print BREAKS the格 outright). Not a labelling difference — 胞胎/印格 and 從煞 prescribe opposite運, so a real decision would flip.

The problem for the bridge: this opposition is NOT cross-lineage. Wan Minying holds BOTH sides. His juan 8 gives the 從煞 answer with the same 尚書 rank that 神峰通考 gives. So what the claim presents as "Authority A vs Authority B" is more accurately "三命通會 juan 11 vs 三命通會 juan 8", with 神峰通考 and 子平真詮 restating the juan-8 side. It is an intra-source inconsistency dressed up as a cross-lineage bridge.

A-juan03 stands apart: it argues from 納音, a layer neither B touches, so it is DIFFERENT_PROPOSITION_COMPATIBLE with respect to B — it agrees on 大貴 and says nothing about格 or 運.

VERDICT: the bridge is DOWNGRADED TO D, not destroyed. The chart is real and both quoted passages exist. What fails is the property the claim was built on — independence — plus one outright fabricated quotation.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM, stated plainly:

1. That the 神峰通考 gloss is Zhang Nan's Ming-era text. I verified the STRING on two unrelated hosts, but both are modern simplified-Chinese e-texts from one digital lineage, with 注释：/歌释： labels, modern punctuation, editorial parentheticals, and heavy OCR corruption elsewhere on the page. No scanned, traditional-character, or Ming/Qing witness was obtainable (ctext.org returned 403 from this network). I cannot rule out that the 注釋 layer is later or modern. Treat "張楠 (明) says X" as unproven; "a circulating edition of 神峰通考 prints X" is what I actually established.

2. That the two authorities are independent. They are not, and this is the finding that decides the grade. 三命通會 卷八, under 乙酉日甲申時, already lists THIS EXACT CHART as 尚書 and already reads it as 從煞 (「此日時遇年月純酉從煞…俱吉」). The claim cites A only from juan 11 and juan 3 and omits juan 8. So Authority A already holds Authority B's position; 神峰通考, written later, reproduces A's chart, A's verdict, and A's rank. That is shared case-stock, not corroboration. The apparent 胞胎格-vs-從煞 tension is an inconsistency INSIDE 三命通會, not a cross-lineage disagreement.

3. The 徐樂吾 quotation. It is fabricated. "乙木无根，气势偏于金，为弃命从煞格。金运最美，水土亦吉。" does not appear in 子平真詮評註 論雜格 — not as a whole, and not as any of its fragments (乙木无根 / 气势偏于金 / 金运最美 all FAIL). Xu's real note there discusses the OTHER case in the passage and says the opposite of the fabricated line: 印則洩煞之氣為不美, where 印 for 乙 is 水, against the invented "水土亦吉". Whoever assembled this claim produced a plausible-sounding commentary that does not exist. That is exactly the failure mode the brief warned about, and it means the whole claim was assembled with at least one unverified retrieval path.

4. Whether 尚書 and 李侍郎 are the same person. Unresolved. The ranks differ between the Ming and Qing lines; either the transmission corrupted the rank or these are two different men assigned the same eight characters. Either way the "same historical subject" premise is unestablished.

WHAT SURVIVES: the eight characters 乙酉 乙酉 乙酉 甲申 are printed, byte-identically, in 三命通會 (juan 3, 8, 11), in 神峰通考 卷六, and in 子平真詮 論雜格. Quote A is verified (one 内/內 slip). Quote B's two classical halves are verified as text. The only genuinely usable decision content in the whole bridge is 沈孝瞻's run rule — 運喜財官，不宜身旺，食傷則尤忌矣 — and it is one line with no chart-specific argument behind it. INDEPENDENCE_GRADE:
DERIVED_WITH_NEW_REASONING

The derivation is documented in B's OWN TEXT, which is decisive. From 子平真詮評註 第47章 論雜格 (https://www.suanzhun.net/book/359.html), raw:

「戊辰一造，見《神峰通考》，為古張知縣命。」

徐樂吾 states outright that this chart came to him from 《神峰通考》. He is not an independent witness to it. And 沈孝瞻's 子平真詮 原文 in that same chapter already carries it (in the defective three-pillar form), so the actual chain is: shared Ming example stock → 神峰通考 → 子平真詮 → 徐樂吾's 評註.

The claim's fallback ("and independently 張楠") inverts the relationship: 張楠 is B's UPSTREAM, not a second corroborator of B.

And 萬民英 vs 張楠 are not independent of each other either. Both Ming, both print the SAME PAIR of charts (戊辰辛酉辛酉戊子 together with 戊辰辛酉辛丑戊子), both anchor the 格 to the SAME 《喜忌篇》 line. Two compilers printing the same example pair against the same verse is a common-source signature, not independent attestation.

What IS independent is the JUDGMENT, and that is real: 徐樂吾 read the Ming source, named it, and rejected its doctrine — 「其說迂曲。何以僅六辛朝陽耶？」 — substituting 金水傷官 / 從旺. New reasoning, opposed conclusion, on an admittedly borrowed chart.

徐樂吾 (民國): unambiguously a distinct historical author. Clean.

萬民英 as "Authority A": weaker than stated. 明通賦 is a pre-existing 賦 that 三命通會 COLLECTS; 萬民英 is compiler-annotator, not composer. 張楠 as "independent Authority B": not established. In the retrieved 神峰通考 section, 張楠's own doctrine is marked 「楠曰」 — and 「楠曰：六阴朝阳格，盖取六辛日…」 does NOT contain the chart. The chart appears under 「補曰」, a supplementary layer written against 《格解》. Attributing the chart line to 張楠 personally is plausible but unverified; it may be an editorial 補注 stratum.

So: two genuinely different authors (萬民英-compilation vs 徐樂吾) — but the specific sentences quoted come from a compiler's gloss and a 補曰 layer respectively, not from two authors speaking in their own voice.
PROPOSITION_A: A 辛 day master with no 午 in the chart, taking a 戊子 hour, constitutes 六陰朝陽格: the 辛 draws 丙 (its 正官) into the chart by 合, and that summoned officer is the source of the chart's nobility. Taboo: 午 (which would break the 子). Favourable: 西方 luck. 戊辰 辛酉 辛酉 戊子 is cited as an INSTANCE of this 格.
PROPOSITION_B: This chart is 金水傷官 and 「原無官星」 — there is no officer star in it at all. Its 氣勢 leans one-sidedly to 金水 and must be followed rather than corrected. Therefore 土金水 luck is favourable, 火 is taboo, water-bearing wood is acceptable, fire-bearing wood is not. 「朝陽格」 is merely what the vulgar tradition calls it (俗所謂). In ch.47 徐樂吾 adds the explicit rejection: the 子動巳→巳動丙 derivation is 迂曲, and if it worked it should not be confined to 辛 days.
SAME_PROPOSITION:
SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER

Both are answering the same question about the same eight characters — why is this chart noble, and by what mechanism. They give incompatible answers on the mechanism, and the incompatibility is explicit rather than inferred: A's whole case rests on 辛合丙官為貴, and B states flatly 「原無官星」. B is denying exactly what A asserts, and (per ch.47) knows he is doing so.

Worth recording for downstream use: on the PRACTICAL question they largely CONVERGE. A prescribes 運喜西方 and taboos 午/火; B prescribes 土金水 and taboos 火. Same operational output, contradictory theory. That combination — agreed prescription, refuted mechanism — is the interesting content here, and it is what actually survived verification.
REFUTATION_NOTES:
The claim is not fabricated — chart and quotations are real, and I retrieved every one of them myself. But the INDEPENDENCE claim, which is the whole point of a "bridge," is refuted by the claim's own source text.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM:
1. That A and B are independent. I confirmed the opposite. 徐樂吾, in the chapter immediately before the one quoted, writes 「戊辰一造，見《神峰通考》，為古張知縣命」 — he names his source. B did not independently attest this chart; he inherited it through 沈孝瞻 from the Ming text the claim offers as its own corroborating "Authority B." 張楠 is upstream of 徐樂吾, not parallel to him.
2. That 萬民英 and 張楠 are independent of each other. Both are Ming, both print the SAME example pair (…辛酉戊子 with …辛丑戊子), both anchored to the same 《喜忌篇》 line. That is a common-source signature. This sub-pair is REPRINT_ONLY in substance.
3. That the quoted sentences are the named authorities speaking. A's chart sits in a compiler's gloss on a 賦 萬民英 did not write. 張楠's chart sits under 「補曰」, not 「楠曰」 — his own 楠曰 paragraph does not contain it.
4. Any traditional-character, scanned, or critical edition of either text. Everything retrieved is a simplified web transcription. Source A's two witnesses share an identical stray quotation mark, so they are one transcription seen twice. The 神峰通考 witness is visibly OCR-corrupt in the same section it is being quoted from, and I could not obtain a second witness for it (ctext 403, udn 403, shidianguji is a JS SPA, guoxuemeng lacks the chapter).
5. The name of the native. 神峰通考 says 張知院; 子平真詮 and 徐樂吾 say 張知縣. Unreconciled inside the claim's own evidence set.

WHAT SURVIVES, and it is worth keeping: on eight characters verified identical to the codepoint across three sources, two lineages give flatly incompatible mechanisms — 辛合丙官為貴 versus 原無官星 — while converging on the same practical prescription (favour 土金水/西方, taboo 火). And the later author knowingly cites the earlier source before rejecting it, which makes the disagreement documented rather than accidental. That is a usable cross-lineage CONTRADICTION case. It is not a case of two independent witnesses confirming anything. If the intended use was corroboration, it fails; if it was documented doctrinal conflict on a fixed chart, it holds at grade D.

PROPOSITION_B: 《滴天髓闡微》臣象, 任氏曰: The day master (臣 = 戊土, tripled) overwhelms the 君 (時上七殺 甲木). A asks a classification question (is 午 a 刃 or an 印 here?) and returns a one-clause verdict, 為貴, propped on a cited maxim. B asks a 君臣 dynamics question and returns a time-indexed trajectory with a moral judgment and a downfall. Their answers converge structurally — both read the fire complex as feeding the 戊 day master (A: 以午火為印; B: 木從火勢，轉生日主) and both yield elevated status (A: 為貴; B: 功名顯赫) — so this is DIFFERENT_PROPOSITION_COMPATIBLE, not a contradiction, and B's 詿誤落職 does not refute A's 貴 because A makes no temporal claim at all. Textual evidence against A deriving from B: A never names 三命通會 or 萬民英; A uses none of B's operative terms (子午冲, 申子會, 陽刃, 財官格) in this chapter; A supplies a proper name (葛參政) that B does not have (葛參政 occurs 0 times in both 卷05 and 卷六). B leaves the subject anonymous ("如一命"). A transmitting text normally loses names, it does not manufacture them — which points to a shared circulating case-book tradition rather than A copying B.
PROPOSITION_A:
沈孝瞻 (論財): Exposed wealth is normally a defect, but exposure is harmless when the wealth generates the officer.

Formally: for a 財-structured chart, 財 transparent in the stems (露) is ordinarily to be avoided because it invites 劫財; however, if 財旺生官, the exposure carries no penalty, because the 官 produced by the 財 drives off the 劫. The stated warrant is an analogy, not a rule-citation: a government treasury under official guard may sit in plain sight, and no one dares rob it (「譬如府庫錢糧，有官守護，即使露白，誰敢劫之？」). 壬申壬子戊午乙卯 is adduced as a worked instance — obviously 財露, yet not to be faulted, 唯其生官.

Note the argumentative role: the chart is A's PROOF CASE for a doctrine about exposure. A asserts nothing about the chart's overall rank, and does not say it is 大貴.
PROPOSITION_B:
萬民英 (論陽刃): A self-sitting 陽刃 does not govern the structure when abundant wealth plus an hour-branch officer restrains it; classify as 財官格.

Formally, four linked steps: (1) 戊午 self-sits 陽刃; (2) the two 壬 with 申 and 子 make 財 both strong and plural (二壬申子，財旺且多); (3) the 子午 clash is defused — 申子 pull 子 into their combination so it cannot strike 午 (「子午雖衝，申子㑹午不能衝」); (4) the hour officer 乙卯 subdues the 陽刃. Therefore the chart is read NOT as a 刃 structure but 只作財官格㸔, and the outcome is 大貴.

Argumentative role: here the chart is B's proof case for a doctrine about STRUCTURE ASSIGNMENT under a neutralized clash — a different doctrine, in a different chapter, from a different starting defect.

REFUTATION_NOTES:
I set out to refute this and could not. The core of the claim survives independent raw retrieval. Below is what I confirmed, then — more importantly — what I could NOT confirm.

CONFIRMED (raw curl + local exact-substring tests in Node; no WebFetch, no summarizer, at any point):
- The chart is identical in both sources at Unicode codepoint level. 戊 U+620A not 戌; 乙 U+4E59 not 己/已/巳.
- Quote B is an EXACT 102-character substring of 三命通會 (四庫全書本) 卷05. The claim's bracketed punctuated variant is also an exact substring of 三命通會/卷六.
- Quote A is present in 子平真詮 卷三 三十三、論財, in order, with one modern editorial bracket intervening.
- The two authorities are genuinely distinct: 萬民英 (Ming, 1578) and 沈孝瞻 (Qing, ~1739/1776). Not a reprint, not one author twice, not one commentary layer twice.
- A and B share no operative vocabulary for this chart. A's 論財 contains zero instances of 三命通會, 萬民英, 羊刃, 子午, 申子.

COULD NOT CONFIRM — four items:

1. That reported text A is a literal contiguous quotation. IT IS NOT. The source prints 「然透一【校：「透一」二字據中州本補】位以清用」; the claim prints 「然透一位以清用」. The claim deleted an editorial note without ellipsis. The note matters beyond tidiness: it discloses that 「透一」 at that spot is a RESTORATION from the 中州本, so the reported wording is at that one point an editor's emendation rather than the 秘本's own reading. The chart sentence is unaffected and fully exact.

2. That B's section is 論羊刃. It is not. The 四庫全書本 heading is 論陽刃〈前論羊刄煞與此𠫵㸔〉, and the string 論羊刃 occurs zero times in 卷05. Wrong chapter name, right volume and right passage.

3. That 沈孝瞻 did not take the CHART from 三命通會 or a common case-book. I have no positive evidence either way — A cites no source for the 葛參政 case, and 三命通會 was a standard reference by A's time. The claim's own framing was backwards here: it asked whether B derives from A, but B predates A by ~160 years, so that direction is chronologically impossible. The reasoning is demonstrably independent; the CASE ITSELF may well be transmitted. That gap is why I graded independence MODERATE rather than HIGH, and it is the single largest soft spot in the bridge.

4. Provenance beyond the digital transcriptions. I could not check any manuscript facsimile. The 東里書齋 page is a modern typed transcription carrying its own editorial layer, and zh.wikisource is a volunteer transcription of the 四庫 recension. I also could not verify that 葛參政 was a real official — B leaves the subject anonymous, so the name rests on A alone and is unattested in the other witness.

PROPOSITIONS ARE NOT THE SAME QUESTION. A asks whether exposed 財 is a defect and answers no, because 財生官 and the 官 guards the treasury against 劫. B asks how to CLASSIFY a chart whose day pillar self-sits 陽刃, and answers 財官格 → 大貴, because 申子 absorbs 子 so the 子午 clash misfires and the hour 官 subdues the 刃. Different chapters, different presenting defects, different doctrines, different vocabularies. They converge only on a shared sub-claim — that 乙卯 官星 is the decisive redeeming element — and both rate the chart favorably. Compatible and mutually reinforcing; not contradictory, and not the same question. Different LABELS here (財格 vs 財官格) are not a contradiction: A never assigns a full 格 to this chart at all.

GRADE B, not A. Same chart verified, two genuinely independent authorities verified, both give substantive usable reasoning — but the questions are related rather than identical, and case-transmission from B to A cannot be excluded. Two citation defects (the dropped editorial bracket in A, the wrong chapter name for B) should be corrected before this bridge is used; neither is fatal.

PROPOSITION_A: In a chart where 財 is heavily exposed on the stems (two 壬 over a 申子 water frame, 財 to a 戊 day-master), the standard defect 「財露」 does not apply, because 財旺生官: exposure is feared only as an invitation to 劫財, and a generated 正官 makes 劫 retreat (「譬如府庫錢糧，有官守護，即使露白，誰敢劫之？」). Question answered: WHAT MAKES THIS BLADE CHART FORTUNATE? Answer: the hour's 正官 subduing the 刃.
SAME_PROPOSITION: DIFFERENT_PROPOSITION_COMPATIBLE. Both conclude the chart is good and both make 乙卯 正官 the pivot, but by different mechanisms answering different questions: B has the 官 SUBDUE the blade (protecting the self); A has the 財 GENERATE the 官, which then GUARDS the wealth from 劫財. Neither asserts the other's claim, so there is no contradiction. There is, however, a latent doctrinal friction worth naming: B's own 日刃 rule states 「四柱中不要入財鄉，怕沖陽刃」 — the blade should avoid 財 territory — while this very chart is saturated with 財 (壬申壬子 water to a 戊 day-master), which is exactly what A celebrates. That tension is an INFERENCE across the two frames, not a disagreement either text states.

(3) THE INDEPENDENCE CLAIM INVERTS THE CHRONOLOGY. The claim asks whether B is derived from A; 淵海子平 predates 子平真詮 by about two centuries, so that is impossible. The real and unrebutted possibility is the reverse — 沈孝瞻 inheriting the 葛參政 case from the earlier corpus. These are therefore NOT two independent attestations of one chart; they are one transmitted case record appearing twice. What is independent is the reasoning, not the evidence. (4) THEY ARE NOT ANSWERING THE SAME QUESTION. A adjudicates whether exposed 財 is a defect; B adjudicates what rescues a 日刃 chart. Compatible, both pivoting on 乙卯 正官, but not one proposition with two verdicts — so the "same question, both detailed" bar for grade A fails, and B's contribution is a single sentence of analysis against A's full paragraph plus 徐樂吾's commentary. The claim's traditional rendering of B, with its 【】 brackets, is a character-conversion of the wikisource simplified e-text, not a quotation from any traditional print edition — the genuine traditional witness I found reads 羊刃 for 陽刃, 「且如」 for 「如」, and 「逢之不安」 for 「逢之為災」. And source A's own chapter has an unstable name attribution nearby: the separate 財格佩印 chart 乙未甲申丙申庚寅 prints as 曾參政 in the classical text while a modern commentator calls its owner 葛從龍 — 葛/曾 drift in this very chapter, which is a reason for caution about 葛參政 as a person, though every witness agrees on 葛參政 for OUR chart. Net: the bridge is real but it is a single case travelling down one transmission line, read through two different doctrinal lenses. Grade C — same chart verified, distinct authorities verified, genuinely different reasoning, but not independent attestation and not the same question.

The two analyses share nothing but the eight chart characters — no citation, no shared phrasing, no shared technical vocabulary. A reasons in 子平 格局 terms (四柱皆煞 / 日主無根 / 從煞格成 / luck-cycle guidance 運喜財官, 忌身旺食傷). B reasons in 納音-神煞-旬 terms, and its reasoning independently checks out: 乙酉 and 甲申 are both 泉中水 nayin, so all four pillars are 水 and 水 has 長生 at 申 (「四水皆生於申」); 乙 stems take 天乙貴人 at 子/申 (乙己鼠猴鄉), so three 乙 stems put three 貴人 on the single 申 (「三貴又聚於申」); and 乙酉 falls inside the 甲申 decade-cycle (「又在旬内」). That internal coherence is independent evidence the B text is not corrupt. NOT graded HIGH because: (a) B calls it an anonymous 一命 while A names it 李侍郎命, so the chart may have travelled through a shared case-book tradition rather than two independent observations; (b) 三命通會 was so widely circulated that 沈孝瞻 borrowing the chart and re-reading it in his own system cannot be excluded from the texts alone. What IS established is that the *reasoning* is not borrowed in either direction.

I also ran the decisive negative control — the test that would have collapsed this bridge. If 萬民英's own corpus assigned this chart to 從煞 elsewhere, the "two authorities disagree" framing would dissolve into an internal ambiguity in one author. I fetched 三命通會 (四庫本) 卷05, 卷08, 卷09, 卷11, 卷12 and counted occurrences:

So 萬民英 knows the 從煞 doctrine, holds it separately, and does not apply it here. The disagreement with 沈孝瞻 is real and survives the control.

Against (why not HIGH): a chart of three identical pillars is exactly the kind of stock teaching example that circulates through the tradition. 三命通會 was enormously widely read, and I cannot rule out that 沈孝瞻 took the eight characters from it (or both took them from a common older stock) and re-read them. I found no evidence he did, but absence of a shared phrase cannot prove non-transmission of a bare chart.

Note this reservation cuts weakly, and arguably in the bridge's favour: even if the chart WAS transmitted, the judgment was not. A transmitted object read two incompatible ways is a stronger bridge than two coincidental encounters, not a weaker one.

PROPOSITION_A:
沈孝瞻 (子平真詮, 論雜格): 乙酉乙酉乙酉甲申 is 棄命從煞 — a 雜格/外格 formed because all four pillars are 煞 and the 日主 (乙木) is rootless, so the self is abandoned and follows the 煞; the 格 is 成大貴.

Formation is conditional on two absences, both stated: 「若有傷食則煞受制而不從，有印則印以化煞而不從」 — food/hurting gods would control the 煞 and印 would transform it, in either case breaking the following.

Prescription: 「運喜財官，不宜身旺，食神傷官，則尤忌矣」 — favour 財 and 官 luck; do not strengthen the self; 食神/傷官 luck is the worst.

Identification: 李侍郎命.
PROPOSITION_B:
萬民英 (三命通會 卷十一, 明通賦解): the same eight characters are 胞胎格 (胎生) — formed because the 天元 (day stem 乙) 自坐絶地, i.e. 乙 is at 絕 on 酉. He generalizes the day-pillar class first (庚寅、辛卯、甲申、乙酉 等日 all self-seated on 絕), then names this chart as the instance: 「如乙酉乙酉乙酉甲申是此格也」.

Character of the native: 其生甚微 — humble origin — but 主少年招受皇恩, receiving imperial favour young; this is his gloss on the 賦 line 「赤子承恩之寵」.

Prescription: 「所以喜印綬怕財尅……大槩與印格同論」 — favour 印綬, fear 財 clashing; treat broadly as an 印 格.
SAME_PROPOSITION:
SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER

Both are answering the same two-part question about the identical chart: which 格 governs it, and what should its luck favour. The differing labels (棄命從煞 vs 胞胎格) are NOT by themselves the contradiction — per the brief, labels alone prove nothing. The contradiction is in the prescriptions, which are stated in the same vocabulary and point opposite ways:

  印: A — 「有印則印以化煞而不從」, 印 destroys the 格 outright.
      B — 「喜印綬」, 印 is the favoured element, 「與印格同論」.
  財: A — 「運喜財官」, 財 favoured.
      B — 「怕財尅」, 財 feared.

Exactly inverted on both axes. This is not a compatible difference of emphasis: one cannot simultaneously favour 印 and have 印 break the 格.

Where they AGREE: both read the chart as producing high status through imperial favour (A: 格成大貴, 李侍郎; B: 少年招受皇恩, 赤子承恩之寵). The outcome axis converges while the mechanism and 用神 axes contradict — which is what makes the pair analytically useful rather than merely discordant.

Both authorities are answering the same question about the same eight characters: what 格 does this chart take, and does the presence of 祿/比劫 disqualify the 從兒 reading? This is not a label collision — the disagreement is at the level of reasoning and is head-on.

One book, one juan, one page, one compiler, one editorial act. A base text and its editor's commentary are two LAYERS of one source, not two independent witnesses. And on the claim's own attribution, A and B's base verse would share the single author 徐子平, collapsing independence completely.

3. THE COMPILER HIMSELF SAYS A DERIVES FROM B. 萬民英's closing note on 明通賦 reads 「喜忌篇繼善篇是從此賦變化而出今人但知有此二篇而不知有此賦故錄之」. The very authority being offered as independent testimony declares that the other text is a derivative of his own base verse.

4. B DEMONSTRABLY HAS A IN HAND. The note immediately preceding the one quoted as B cites 繼善篇 BY NAME. A further gloss quotes two 繼善篇 lines as 「賦云」. The commentary layer reads and absorbs A; it does not arrive at anything independently.

5. THE TWO PASSAGES DO NOT DISAGREE. The passage offered as the opposing sequencing authority contains 「故月為提綱」 — verbatim agreement with A's 「月令乃提綱」, with a causal justification added. A partitions 貴賤/吉凶; B partitions 命/運. 「先言日干次言月支」 describes the line order of the couplet 萬民英 is annotating, not a doctrinal priority rule. There is no cross-lineage tension here to bridge.

6. NO CHART. The rubric's "same chart" precondition for grades A/B/C cannot be met by a claim that states no chart exists.

VERDICT: REFUTED. The quotations are authentic; the bridge built on them is not. This is a single source quoted twice — a compiler's gloss on a verse he printed himself, in a book whose own commentary states the two texts are one lineage — presented as two independent authorities in tension. It should not be used as cross-lineage corroboration for anything.

PROPOSITION_A: 沈孝瞻: the determination of 用神 is anchored on the month branch and nowhere else. 用神 is read off the day-stem-to-month-branch relation, from which 格局 is divided (「八字用神，專求月令，以日干配月令地支，而生剋不同，格局分焉」). The ten gods then split by nature — 財官印食 are 善 and taken 順用, 煞傷劫刃 are 不善 and taken 逆用. Analysts who fail to make the 提綱 the governing term and instead refer every stem and branch back to the month command indiscriminately produce systematic misreadings, itemized in five paired confusions (官印雙全 vs 正官佩印, 食神生財 vs 財逢食生, etc.), all of which he attributes to one cause: 「此皆由不知月令而妄論之故也」. Even the residual case where the month branch yields no usable 用神 (建祿/月劫) does not license abandoning it: another 用神 is sought from the remaining pillars, but 「終以月令為主，然後尋用」 — the month command remains the axis of the search. The witness-2 text adds the sharper form: to seek 用神 anywhere but the month command is 「執假失真」.
PROPOSITION_B: 陳素庵: reading a chart begins at the day stem, assessed for 得時/失時 and 得勢/失勢, then its seated branch and the stem adjacent to it, then the remaining three stems and four branches, each evaluated for 生剋扶抑 upon the day stem — 「此恆法也」. And the same audit is then run recursively over every other stem and branch as its own subject (year stem, month stem, hour stem, then year branch, month branch, hour branch), because 「不特日干而已，凡柱中干支皆當如此研究」. Only after that complete survey is role assignment permitted — 「如此一一研究的確，然後用之為官煞，為財印，為食傷，其是強是弱，當用當捨」 — and he stakes the whole method on this ordering: 「此看命第一要訣也」. Separately and definitionally, 用神 is not a structural label at all but a balancing operator: 「命以用神為緊要。看用神之法，不過扶抑而已」 — support the weak, restrain the strong, applied recursively (over-support is itself restrained, under-support is itself supported) and at four levels: 日主, 六神, 原局, 行運.

REFUTATION_NOTES:
REFUTED. The quotations are real; the bridge built on them is not.

WHAT I COULD CONFIRM (independently, by raw retrieval): both quotes exist literally in the cited pages, character-for-character including B's punctuation. The two authorities are genuinely distinct Ming authors (明 萬民英 撰 / 明 张楠 著), with no reprint or derivation relationship and no shared boilerplate in the compared chapter. Methodologically I never invoked WebFetch — I pulled action=raw wikitext over curl and string-matched offline, so no summarizing layer touched any string above.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM — the load-bearing claim: that Authority A states a "化氣-first rule". It does not. Three independent findings:

(1) 「凡命先論化氣」 is one of FOUR parallel 「凡…先…」 paragraph openers inside the SAME 「㸔命口訣」 section, each nominating a different thing as "first": @235 先㸔月支有無財官 (財官 first), @1546 先㸔干神有無尅制 (stem clashes first), @2241 先論化氣 (化氣 first), @5738 先論五行體面局勢 (five-phase configuration first). Four mutually incompatible "firsts" in one chapter is not four doctrines — it is a rhetorical section-opening formula meaning "as a general matter, regarding X…". Extracting one of the four and reading it as a global sequencing rule is selection, not evidence.

(2) The FIRST of those openers, ~2,000 characters before the quoted one, is 「大凡㸔命先㸔月支有無財官方㸔其他」 — 財官 first, then everything else, using the very same 方 fallback particle B uses. That is the DIRECT INVERSE of B's 「从化不成，方论财官」. So if 三命通會 卷十 asserts any sequencing doctrine at all, the one it asserts most explicitly CONTRADICTS B. The claim selected the one paragraph that appears to agree and did not report the nearer one that disagrees.

(3) Read in context, quote A is not about ordering at all — it is a mechanism for deciding 本體-vs-化 by day/night birth and 五運 太過/不及. It never mentions 格局, never says what happens when 化 fails, and supplies no ladder. Elsewhere the same juan prints 「財官欲真致妙兮須理化氣」 — 財官 REQUIRES understanding 化氣, i.e. interdependence, not B's exclusive precedence.

FURTHER UNDISCLOSED WEAKNESSES: source B is a bare unsourced simplified-character e-text with no header, no edition statement, no scan backing, modern editorial punctuation, and an admitted emendation — a materially weaker witness than A's scan-backed 四庫 transcription. The claim's traditional-form section title 「十干從化定訣」 does not occur on the cited page (it prints 十干从化定诀). And quote A's own text is orthographically unstable on the exact 己/巳 axis I was asked to check (乙丁巳辛癸, 六巳人, alongside a correct 六己), an artifact of the source, not the claimant.

ONE SALVAGEABLE FINDING, offered as my own and NOT as confirmation: a real same-proposition confrontation does exist between these two passages, but on a different question. A states 「如六甲日生木夜生化土」 — a 甲 day-master born at night IS read as 化土. B states 「惟甲木则无从化之理」 — 甲木 alone has no principle of 從化. Same proposition (can 甲 undergo 化?), opposite answers, two independent Ming authorities. That would be a SAME_PROPOSITION_DIFFERENT_ANSWER pair worth grading. Caveat before anyone builds on it: B's 甲木 clause sits immediately after 「赋云：」 and may fall inside the quoted 赋 rather than being 張楠's own assertion — attribution is ambiguous in the transcription and would need a punctuated critical edition to settle.

Bottom line: chart N/A, quotes VERIFIED, authorities VERIFIED and INDEPENDENT_HIGH, proposition identity FAILS. Bridge grade REFUTED. A defensible D would require restating the claim far more weakly as "two independent Ming authorities both mention 化/從化 among things considered early" — which carries none of the asserted doctrinal weight.

Both authorities are answering the identical explanandum: *what structural feature of this chart accounts for its holder reaching top-rank office?* Neither is discussing a side question.

THEY CONVERGE on two points — genuine agreement, independently reached:
- Day-master strength: A says 身強, B says 身旺. SAME ANSWER.
- Outcome domain: A says 職掌兵權震外夷, B says 以軍功顯貴至一品. Both independently specify MILITARY attainment. SAME ANSWER.

THEY CONTRADICT on the core structural question — and this is the substance of the bridge. Both are characterising the SAME element (the water sitting in 申, reinforced by 辰), and they assign it opposite polarity AND opposite quantity:
- 張楠: it is 七殺, and it is 淺 — DEFICIENT. The chart is therefore incomplete as it stands and REQUIRES 北方 luck to supply what is missing (補其水).

So this is not a difference of LABEL over an agreed structure. It is a substantive disagreement about whether the chart's officer-element is deficient-and-needs-luck or prosperous-and-self-sufficient — reached from the same eight characters, by two authors using incommensurable frameworks, both arriving at the same verdict of high military nobility by opposite routes.

WHY GRADE A DESPITE THE ABOVE. The grading criteria are same chart, two independent authorities, same question, both detailed, verified — and each is met. The URL error is a defect in the CLAIM's citation, not in the underlying bridge, and I have supplied the correction. The bridge's analytical value is higher than the claim asserted. This is not merely two authorities agreeing on a noble chart. WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM, AND WHAT REFUTES THE BRIDGE:

1. THE CITED URL FOR B IS WRONG. KR3g0042_009.txt does not contain the 長流龍 passage — I downloaded all 12 juan and it appears only in KR3g0042_011.txt (卷十一). The researcher cited a file that does not contain the text they quoted. That is the signature of a citation assembled rather than retrieved.

2. AUTHORITY A IS MISATTRIBUTED. The claim concedes the passage is not marked 楠曰; my check shows why that matters. The identical text — with an EXTRA chart (張皇親 丙戌甲午丁巳癸卯) and two 詩曰 that 神峰通考 drops — sits as an 眉批 on the same 喜忌篇 line in 淵海子平 (8bei8 yuanhaiziping_75.html, verified raw). Minor wording drift (柱中有 vs 其中若; 此丐者 vs 此乃丐者) confirms a shared ancestor rather than either copying the other. "Authority A = 張楠" is therefore false; A is anonymous floating Ming commentary apparatus that travels with the 喜忌篇 verse. Two books printing the same 眉批 is one witness, not two.

3. 張楠'S ACTUAL VOICE ATTACKS B'S METHOD. If you insist on 神峰通考 as an authority, it is a hostile one: 五星謬說類 uses 庚辰甲申癸亥癸亥 — a 辰-year, 癸亥-day, 癸亥-hour chart — as a counterexample and asks 「亦可以龍歸大海論之，何以極貧？」, and 楠曰 at p.12 calls the 納音-dragon reading 「不根理之所有，何其謬哉」. The two sources do not converge; on method they collide.

4. B DISQUALIFIES ITSELF AS INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE. 「此亦因陽明而立論」 — 萬民英 states the rule was formulated because of 陽明. A rule derived from the case cannot corroborate a reading of the case. This is a post-hoc fit, self-declared.

5. B'S SECOND WITNESS IS IN A CONTAMINATED LIST. The 卷九 王守仁 entry sits in a case-list whose own colophon says 「原本十之六增十之四」 and which names 周延儒, who died in 1644, 41 years after 萬民英. I cannot establish that the 卷九 entry is 萬民英's.

6. UNVERIFIED SIDE POINT: I could not confirm the 「卷五」 locus for A. Neither digitization carries 卷 markers there.

VERDICT: the chart and both quotations survive; the BRIDGE does not. Grade D — same chart, real text, but ambiguous/misattributed authority identity on side A, a wrong citation on side B, and a rule on side B that admits it was reverse-engineered from the case. This is not two independent lineages converging on 王陽明's chart; it is one anonymous commentary layer plus one self-declared retrofit, with the named author of side A on record rejecting side B's reasoning.

REFUTATION_NOTES:
I could not refute the core of the claim. The chart and both quotations are real, and I verified all three by raw retrieval, not summarization. But four things in the claim are wrong or unconfirmable, and one structural objection keeps this off grade A.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM:
1. The cited URL for Authority B is wrong. KR3g0042_010.txt fetched fine (HTTP 200) but is 卷十 and contains zero occurrences of the chart. The passage lives in KR3g0042_003.txt (卷三). Anyone re-checking the claim at the given URL would find nothing and conclude fabrication.
2. The section attribution for B is half wrong. The chart's commentary attaches to 「紆紫拖朱居帝京」, not to 「煞神和主兩長生」 — that is the following couplet, whose own commentary gives an entirely different example (壬寅見辛巳、乙酉見甲申之類).
3. Authority A's person-level attribution is not established. 神峰通考 marks 張楠's own voice 「楠曰」 (142 occurrences) separately from 「注释」 (139 occurrences). Quote A is a 注释. Calling this "張楠's judgment" is unsupported; it is an anonymous commentary layer in his book. The claim was honest about this, and it is a real weakness, not a technicality.
4. Quote B as reported does not literally exist in the primary edition. The 四庫/WYG text reads 於, the reported string reads 于, plus simplified conversion throughout. Substance is identical; the string is not. I found no independent second digitization of B — 8bei8's 三命通會 卷三 pages do not carry this passage at all.

WHAT SURVIVED:
- Chart identical in both, eight for eight. The 己/已/巳 and 戊/戌 confusion classes do not occur in this chart at all.
- Quote A is an EXACT literal match (grep -F, 1 hit) against raw page HTML.
- Quote B is verbatim present in the 四庫全書 primary, modulo orthography.
- Two genuinely different Ming works, different authors, different editions. Not a reprint.
- Derivation is chronologically impossible in the B←A direction: A's commentary layer self-dates to ≥1589 (it cites 「即今萬曆十七年算起」 and speaks in first person), while 三命通會 is 1578. And no A←B borrowing is visible, because the two share no reasoning vocabulary whatsoever — A argues 從煞/十神/五行性情, B argues 納音四水長生/三貴聚申/旬內. Neither mentions the other's mechanism.

THE STRUCTURAL OBJECTION THAT CAPS THIS AT B:
This is not two lineages independently observing a person. It is a circulating stock case that different doctrinal machines each chew on. Searching all twelve juan of 三命通會 shows the SAME author uses this same chart a second time, in 卷十一, under a THIRD and doctrinally incompatible reading: 「此庚寅辛卯甲申乙酉等日皆本主天元自坐絶地為胎生之宫即胞胎格也…所以喜印綬怕財尅…如乙酉乙酉乙酉甲申是此格也」. 胞胎格 wanting 印綬 and fearing 財 is the opposite prescription to A's 從煞, which rejects 印 and welcomes 財 feeding the 煞. So Authority B's own corpus contains a reading that conflicts with Authority A's, which considerably weakens any story of two lineages converging. The chart also recurs later as a stock 從煞格 example in 子平真詮/評註 (locally held corpus/ZPZQPZ_048.txt, unverified online by me).

So: same chart, two independent authorities, related-but-not-identical question, both give usable reasoning — grade B. Not A, because the claim's own citation for B is materially false, A's authorial voice is unattributed, and the two texts assert different propositions that merely happen to share the outcome label 貴.

Formally (as the 淵海子平 喜忌篇 註, reprinted in 神峰通考 卷五): where the 官星 and 財氣 sit on 長生 within the four 孟 branches 寅申巳亥, the chart forms a 四孟 configuration. Applied to 壬申 辛亥 己巳 丙寅: for a 己 day master, 甲 (官) is 長生 in 亥, 壬 (財) is 長生 in 申, 丙 (印綬) is 長生 in 寅 — a triple-長生 of 官/財/印 across the 孟 positions.

Verdict asserted: 先榮後辱 — glory first, disgrace after.

Note the variant matters here. 淵海子平 closes 「此爲四孟凶局」 (an INAUSPICIOUS 四孟 configuration); the 神峰通考 witness closes 「此四孟格局」 (merely a 四孟 pattern), dropping 凶. Source A as retrieved therefore states the adverse judgment only in 先榮後辱, not in its closing label.
PROPOSITION_B:
Formally (三命通會 卷三, under 「寅申巳亥四宫互換神煞」, glossing a 七言 古歌 on 亡神/劫煞): if 寅申巳亥 are all present but 長生 is "not met", the life is hard to prolong; the native is far-scheming and bold but ends in disgrace, with no final result.

Applied by 萬民英's interlinear note to 韓平原 (Han Tuozhou, Southern Song chancellor, beheaded 1207) with chart 壬申辛亥己巳丙寅: 「如此大貴不免斬首」 — rank this high, yet he did not escape beheading; and for a commoner the same structure would simply yield no result at all. A second example, 禇冲夷, is appended.

The governing frame is 神煞 (亡神/劫煞 in the 四孟), not 財官印 格局.

REFUTATION_NOTES:
WHAT I CONFIRMED: the chart is real and identical in both cited passages (codepoint-verified, 己 U+5DF1 + 巳 U+5DF3, no confusion). Both reported quotes exist as literal text. I obtained every quotation by raw retrieval — curl to file, sed tag-strip, literal grep, PowerShell codepoint indexing — never through a summarizer.

WHAT I COULD NOT CONFIRM, AND WHAT BREAKS THE CLAIM:

1. Source A is not an independent authority. It is the 淵海子平 喜忌篇 annotation reprinted inside 神峰通考. I retrieved 淵海子平 independently and the two texts differ in exactly two spots (神峰通考 adds 「巳中有金長生」; 「四孟格局」 for 「四孟凶局」). The adjacent lemma and its commentary are shared too. The 8bei8 edition itself notes on its 卷四 page that this material duplicates 淵海子平. The claimant's own remark that the passage is "not marked 楠曰" is exactly the diagnostic that it is not 張楠's layer. So the pairing is not two authorities — it is one inherited gloss plus one commentator.

2. Source B's URL is wrong. KR3g0042_009.txt (卷九) fetched fine but contains zero instances of 寅申巳亥, 韓平原, or the chart. The passage is in KR3g0042_003.txt (卷三), under 「寅申巳亥四宫互換神煞」. Content true, citation false.

3. The reasoning is not novel to either side. 萬民英 himself records source A's exact framework in 三命通會 卷六: 「或以己用甲為官丙為印，歸祿時下，甲木亥月長生…丁卯年遂遭極刑，夀止五十六，亦是一説」 — and tags it 「亦是一説」, "this too is one account", i.e. a circulating opinion he is reporting, not producing. He also quotes 楊良講 for a competing 納音劍鋒金 reading of the same chart. So the 官/財/印-長生 analysis was already common property that BOTH cited texts draw from.

4. A premise tension the claim glosses over. A asserts 長生 IS present (三長生 of 官/財/印). B's verse headline asserts 長生不遇 — 長生 NOT met. Same chart, opposite-sounding premises; they align only because each uses 長生 of a different referent. The shared "glory then ruin" verdict is a convergent outcome, not a shared derivation.

GRADE D, not REFUTED: the chart and both texts are genuine and do pair on the same eight characters — this is not fabrication. But "two independent authorities" fails on reprint, so the bridge cannot carry independence weight.

SALVAGEABLE VERSION: the defensible pairing is 淵海子平 喜忌篇 註 (the ancestor, reproduced in 神峰通考) against 三命通會 卷三's 神煞 verse note. Those are genuinely different lineages and different mechanisms on the same chart — but B's side is one sentence of outcome with no derivation, so that pairing grades C at best. Anyone rebuilding it should cite 卷三, cite 淵海子平 as the source of the A-side reasoning, and stop calling 神峰通考 an independent authority for it.
